description: Na₅IO₆ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent IO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-22°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.40 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent IO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent IO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-22°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.62 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent IO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent IO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-18°. There are four shorter (2.29 Å) and two longer (2.78 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one I⁷⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅I octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. The O-I bond length is 1.91 Å. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na¹⁺ and one I⁷⁺ atom. The O-I bond length is 1.88 Å. I⁷⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form IO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra and edges with twelve NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°.
